---
title: "Build publication tables and figures"
---

## Purpose

Collect the checked analysis results into the final manuscript and
supplementary tables and figures without copying files by hand.

## What this notebook uses and produces

- Uses: approved descriptive, placement, H01--H11, and sensitivity-analysis
  results.
- Produces: the final main-text and supplementary tables and figures; CSV files
  containing the exact displayed data; a map linking each manuscript element
  to the notebook or script that generated it; a map linking claims to results;
  and file checksums, which act as digital fingerprints. These files are
  stored under `artifacts/09_tables/` through `artifacts/12_manifests/`.
- Fixed rules: every manuscript display has one identified notebook or script
  that generates it. Manually copied files in `assets/` are not used as the
  source of a result. Preparing the journal-upload folder remains a separate
  final step.

```{r}
#| label: setup-artifact-assembly
#| eval: false

root <- normalizePath(
  Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR"),
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)
source(file.path(root, "scripts/pipeline/paths_io.R"))
source(file.path(root, "scripts/pipeline/assertions.R"))

paths <- pipeline_paths(root)
```

The notebook will stop with a clear error if a required generating file, input
checksum, source-data file, caption, unit, or output-map entry is missing.
